Download the app you want, unzip it and open the program inside - that's all. It installs itself, adds its Desktop
and Start Menu shortcuts, sets up everything it needs (Python and its parts, Microsoft Edge WebView2) and keeps
itself up to date.

| App | Download | Open |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Novulon's Wicked Animator** - make WickedWhims animations without Blender | **WickedAnimator.zip** below | Wicked Animator.exe |
| **Novulon's Sims Hub** - fast loading, lag fixes and tidy mods for The Sims 4 | **SimsHub.zip** below | Sims Hub.exe |

Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" the first time (the apps are not code-signed): click **More info**, then
**Run anyway**.
